Nek'zali the Soulcoiler: [제어] Stun several Restless Amani with their Gravebound Advance shields still up using Capacitor Totem to delay them reaching the well.
[생존기] When Soulcoil Ignition triggers Soulcoil Rite every second for 4 sec, reduce damage taken by 40% with Astral Shift.
@m [차단] If you are on the well-kill team, interrupt Drowned Echo's Soulcoiler's Curse with Wind Shear.

Entombed Sentinels: [우선 처치] When a Venom Coagulation ooze spawns, pop Ascendance to kill it right away.
[참고] The boss takes 99% less damage during Vitriolic Stasis, so hold Ascendance until after the intermission.
[생존기] When soaking Unstable Miasma, reduce damage taken by 40% with Astral Shift.

Vashnik the Malignant: [우선 처치] AoE down the venom adds with Crash Lightning and Chain Lightning before they reach the center.
[제어] Burning Venom can be stunned with Capacitor Totem until Hardened Venom.
@m [생존기] Line up Astral Shift with Gloom Expulsion and Conflagrating Expulsion.

The Lost Explorers: [차단] Interrupt Scrollsage Iku's Icebound Flames with Wind Shear.
[위치] If you are the Blink Nova target, get away from the raid quickly with Spirit Walk or Ghost Wolf.
[우선 처치] While balancing the three bosses' health, use Crash Lightning and Chain Lightning so the damage also hits First Mate Nama.

Sszorak: [생존기] Sszorak takes more damage during the 25 sec Dig In, so line up Ascendance with it.
[분담] When soaking Mutilate, reduce damage taken by 40% with Astral Shift.
[회피] If the Tempest whirlwinds hit and slow you, remove the movement impairment with Spirit Walk and get out.

The Twin Fangs: [우선 처치] Kill the Venomous Emergence adds first by popping Ascendance and using Crash Lightning.
[생존기] When soaking Ravenous Feast, reduce damage taken by 40% with Astral Shift.
@m [차단] Interrupt Broodling of Ithraz's Visceral Burst and Caustic Globule's Barbed Bulwark with Wind Shear.

The Coiled Altar: [차단] Once the Veil of Twilight shield breaks, interrupt Eternal Nightfall with Wind Shear.
[우선 처치] Ghastly Regeneration in the intermission makes Zul'jan take 100% more damage, so dump Ascendance.
[회피] After soaking Guillotine, immediately get 40 yards away from the axe with Spirit Walk or Ghost Wolf.

Ula'tek: [해제] Clear the Acidic Burst poison from Blightscale Viper off allies within 30 yards with Poison Cleansing Totem.
[우선 처치] Dump Ascendance into the Venomous Heart exposed after Rage of the Shackled.
[차단] Interrupt Malice, Anguished Cry, and Vicious Echoes with Wind Shear.

Nymrissa Wavecaller: [우선 처치] Kill the Bubblefin Shorerunners drawn in by Alluring Bubble with Crash Lightning and Chain Lightning before they reach the bubble.
[생존기] Line up Astral Shift with the raid damage from Pop! and Unending Tides.
@m [우선 처치] Waterfog Shield reduces damage to nearby murlocs by 99%, so kill the Bubblefin Frostscale before using AoE.

Imperator Averzian: [차단] In the intermission, interrupt Pitch Bulwark from Shadowguard Stalwart and Voidbound Annihilator with Wind Shear.
[우선 처치] AoE down the Voidmaw packs with Crash Lightning and Sundering.
@m [해제] Abyssal Malus's Black Miasma is a Curse, so remove it with Cleanse Spirit.

Vorasius: [회피] Even if Creep Spit has slowed you, remove the movement impairment with Spirit Walk during Void Breath and run to the far end of the room opposite the glowing hand.
[우선 처치] Kill the Blistercreeps gathered at the wall together with Crash Lightning so Blisterburst breaks the Void Crystal.
@m [생존기] When the first Blistercreep pack pops, reduce damage taken with Astral Shift.

Fallen-King Salhadaar: [우선 처치] When Concentrated Void orbs spawn, close in right away with Feral Lunge and kill them before they reach the boss.
[차단] Interrupt Shadow Fracture from the nearest Fractured Image with Wind Shear or hold it with Capacitor Totem.
[참고] The boss takes 25% more damage during the 20 sec Entropic Unraveling, so line up Ascendance and Doom Winds with it and reduce the raid damage with Astral Shift.

Vaelgor & Ezzorak: [차단] Interrupt Voidorb's Voidbolt with Wind Shear or hold it with Capacitor Totem.
[분담] When taking Gloomtouched in the Gloom path, reduce damage taken with Astral Shift.

Lightblinded Vanguard: [참고] The Divine Shield the boss casts after Bloodlust can be removed by an enemy buff dispel, so remove it with Purge.
[차단] After breaking War Chaplain Senn's Sacred Shield, interrupt Blinding Light with Wind Shear.
[분담] When soaking Execution Sentence next to the target, reduce damage taken with Astral Shift.

Crown of the Cosmos: [우선 처치] Kill the Void Droplets under the sentinel by hitting them together with the sentinel using Crash Lightning.
[회피] When Vorelus's Ravenous Abyss comes, get 15 yards out with Spirit Walk.
@nh [차단] Interrupt Undying Voidspawn's Void Barrage with Wind Shear or hold it with Capacitor Totem.

Chimaerus the Undreamt God: [차단] Interrupt Haunting Essence's Fearsome Cry first with Wind Shear.
[우선 처치] If you are on the lower floor team, save Ascendance and Doom Winds to break the adds' Alnshroud shields quickly.
[회피] Get out of the Phase 2 Corrupted Devastation path with Spirit Walk while killing adds.

Belo'ren, Child of Al'ar: [차단] If your feather color matches, interrupt the embers' Light Eruption or Void Eruption with Wind Shear.
[생존기] Bloodlust goes on the first egg phase, so when Rebirth starts, use Bloodlust or Heroism and dump Ascendance and Doom Winds.
[분담] When soaking Light Dive or Void Dive with same-color players, reduce damage taken with Astral Shift.

Midnight Falls: @nh [차단] Interrupt the Safeguard Matrix's Safeguard casts with Wind Shear and Capacitor Totem, and strip the stacked Safeguard buff with Purge.
@m [차단] Interrupt Terminate from your assigned Termination Matrix in order with Wind Shear.
@m [생존기] Bloodlust is used in Phase 3, so use Bloodlust or Heroism then.

Rotmire: @hm [차단] Always interrupt Sporecap's Poison Burst with Wind Shear.
@hm [해제] Clear a Poison Burst poison DoT that slips past interrupts off nearby players with Poison Cleansing Totem.
[위치] If you are the Festering Vines target, remove the slow with Spirit Walk and move to the edge of the room.

note: There is no spec-specific source for each raid boss, so these are general principles written by matching ability tooltips to boss mechanics.

notes: Poison Cleansing Totem은 digest 해제 목록에서 독으로 확인된 Acidic Burst에만 썼다. Cleanse Spirit이 지울 저주 디버프는 digest에 없다. Sszorak의 Tempest는 보스 회오리 기술이며 주술사 Tempest가 아니다
Gravebound Advance 보호막을 깨는 피해 속성은 적지 않았다. Stormbringer·Totemic 전용 기술(Surging Totem·Tempest 등)은 넣지 않았다
1시즌: Cleanse Spirit·Poison Cleansing Totem은 kit.dispel 기준으로 digest 해제 목록의 저주(Black Miasma)·독(Poison Burst)에만 썼다. Purge는 digest가 적 버프 해제를 요구한 Divine Shield·Safeguard에만 썼다
1시즌: Spirit Walk는 툴팁 '이동 방해 효과 제거·이동 속도 60%'만 근거로 Creep Spit·Festering Vines 감속에 썼다. 폭풍인도자·토템술사 영웅 특성 전용 기술(Surging Totem·Tempest 등)은 넣지 않았다
